howToApply: Go to the recruitment portal of the High Court of Kerala.
Complete ‘One Time Registration’ using the ‘One Time Registration Login’ link.
Keep ready the scanned images of photograph and signature, details of qualification, etc.
Enter the required details in ‘My Profile’.
Apply for the post from ‘Apply Now’ in ‘Dashboard’ and proceed as per the instructions on the screen.
Check the preview of the application before submission. Once submitted, no changes, editing, or modification can be made.
For candidates applying from abroad, send an email detailing their location with public IP address to recruitment.hckerala@nic.in.

howToApply: Visit the PMIS Portal at https://pminternship.mca.gov.in/login/
Read the User Manual published on PMIS portal (https://pminternship.mca.gov.in > Manuals > Candidate User Manual) before filing the online application.
Ensure you meet the eligibility requirements by checking the scheme details at https://pminternship.mca.gov.in.
Submit the application through the PMIS Portal.
Ensure that marks are entered correctly as any discrepancy will lead to rejection of application.
No application fee is required.
